template.title: Chase unpaid invoices with a reminder cadence (dunning)
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants customers with overdue unpaid invoices reminded by e-mail, politely first and firmer later, from their invoice sheet; optionally a summary to themselves.
template.notFor: Sending invoices, taking payments, charging cards, paying suppliers or contractors, or chasing anything that is not an invoice in the invoices sheet.

slots.name: firstAfterDays
slots.description: Days after the due date when the first, friendly reminder goes out.

slots.name: secondAfterDays
slots.description: Days after the due date for a firmer second reminder; 0 means no second reminder.

slots.name: finalAfterDays
slots.description: Days after the due date for a final notice; 0 means no final notice.

slots.name: signature
slots.description: Who the reminders are signed by, e.g. a name and business name.

slots.name: sendSummary
slots.description: Also e-mail the person a summary of the invoices that are due for a reminder.

slots.name: summaryTo
slots.question: Which e-mail address should get the summary?
slots.askWhy: The summary lists your customers and what they owe; I will not guess where it goes.
slots.description: The person's own e-mail address for the summary (only when sendSummary is true; empty otherwise).

constraints.message: secondAfterDays must be later than firstAfterDays (or 0 for no second reminder)
finalAfterDays must be later than firstAfterDays (or 0 for no final notice)
finalAfterDays must be later than secondAfterDays (or 0)

data.invoices: one row per invoice: invoice (id), customer, email, amount, due (YYYY-MM-DD), status (open | paid | disputed)

willDo: Read the invoices sheet and pick the open invoices (not paid, not disputed)
Send each invoice at most one reminder of each kind, ever: it remembers what it already sent

willDo.text: E-mail [[summaryTo]] a summary of the invoices due for a reminder

willDo: Check, by re-reading the outbox, that exactly the planned reminders went out, each intact
willNotDo: Remind customers whose invoice is paid or disputed
Take payments, charge cards or change the invoices sheet
Contact anyone except the e-mail address on each invoice
Run by itself on a schedule: you (or your coding agent) start each run

workflow.title: Invoice reminders
workflow.goal: Each run, e-mail every customer whose open invoice is overdue the reminder its age calls for ([[cadenceText]]), never twice for the same stage, after a person approves each send.

assumptions: The invoices sheet holds one row per invoice with invoice, customer, email, amount, due (YYYY-MM-DD) and status (open, paid or disputed)
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: Chasing a customer who already paid or disputes the invoice
Sending a reminder to the wrong address
successCriteria: Every overdue open invoice got the reminder its age calls for
This run delivered exactly the planned reminders, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Keep open invoices only (not paid, not disputed)
Work out how many days late each open invoice is
Decide which reminder each invoice is due for
Keep the invoices due for a reminder
Remind each customer once per stage
Note who this reminder is for
Remember this reminder; skip it if it was sent before

args.text:
Hello {{customer}},

{{opening}} Invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}} was due on {{due}} ({{days}} days ago) and we have not received payment yet.

If you have already paid, please ignore this message. If something about the invoice is wrong, just reply and we will sort it out.

Thank you,
[[signature]]

nodes.description: E-mail the reminder to the customer (asks you first)
List the reminders this run actually sent
Who should have received a reminder this run
List the invoices due for a reminder
E-mail the summary to [[summaryTo]] (asks you first)
Re-read the outbox: exactly the planned e-mails went out this run, each intact
